subject: MAP: MedLytics POC — environment handoff, API keys & peering cadence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: MAP: MedLytics POC — environment handoff, API keys & peering cadence

Alex — thanks again for the time today. I captured the immediate asks and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) slice focused on environment access: API keys, org setup, IP allowlist, and VPC peering. Attaching a working MAP workbook and network requirements PDF for reference.

High-level asks from MedLytics (recap):
- Testworthy staging with dedicated tenant + API keys (no production data).
- IP allowlist + service account for CI integration.
- VPC peering for bulk transfer tests (short window).
- 3-week close runway to evaluate latency/cost on your sample workload.

Proposed next steps (quick):
1) Redwood to provision a MedLytics staging org and seed two API keys (one admin, one read-only) — target: 48 hours.
2) MedLytics to provide public-facing egress IPs and CIDR for allowlist — target: 48 hours after step 1.
3) Jonas to review the peering template and confirm compatibility — target: 2 business days.
4) Joint smoke test and performance run — target week of Nov 29.

Milestone summary (draft):
- 11/23: Org & API keys provisioned by Redwood.
- 11/25: IP allowlist + credentials validated.
- 11/30: VPC peering established (if required).
- 12/06: Final evaluation run + close decision.

Please review the MAP tab in the attached MAP_MedLytics_v1.xlsx and the network_requirements_20261121.pdf for the exact IP/CIDR format we need. Jonas — I'm looping you in to confirm the peering template viability and any additional firewall rules we should ask for.

If this looks good, Alex — can you confirm the admin contact for org invites and your preferred time window for the peering (we'll try to keep it in a low-traffic window)?

Thanks —
Soojin

Subject: Re: MAP: MedLytics POC — environment handoff, API keys & peering cadence

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful and aligns with our expectations. A couple of clarifications from our side before we lock dates: 

1) For the API keys: we prefer the admin key to be short-lived (7 days) for onboarding and then rotated to a long-running integration key. Can Redwood support a rotation schedule (we have CI that expects a static integration key)?

2) VPC peering: we can do peering but need to confirm CIDR ranges and whether BGP is required (we prefer simple static routes).

3) Org setup: invite Priya Rao (cloud infra) as admin. Priya will also own the firewall updates on our side.

We are okay with the milestone dates provided but ask that the VPC peering target be flagged as "optional" in the MAP — if we can validate throughput over public endpoints for the evaluation run, we may skip peering unless the bulk transfer test shows significant difference.

Action: Priya and I will send the egress IP list and our preferred peering window by EOD tomorrow.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Engineering
MedLytics
alex.johnson@medlytics.com

Note: attaching our internal networking contact card in-line in a follow-up to avoid attachment blocking on our corporate filter.

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medlytics.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-23T08:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: MAP: MedLytics POC — environment handoff, API keys & peering cadence

Hi Alex — quick technical notes to make the handoff concrete. I reviewed your network posture and the attached template (vpc-peer-template.txt). Summary below.

IP allowlist / egress requirements:
- We need a list of public egress IPs (single IPs or a /32 list) for the median test agents and CI runners. Example format: 203.0.113.45/32
- If you have NAT gateways in front of your CI, please provide NAT IPs rather than private ranges.

API key provisioning & rotation:
- We can create two keys: onboarding-admin (TTL 7 days) and integration-read (long-lived). After onboarding, we recommend switching to the integration-read key and rotating the admin key off.
- Key rotation: Redwood supports key rotation via the Console API (POST /orgs/<org>/keys/rotate). We will also provide a short script to rotate keys; sample in vpc-peer-template.txt.

VPC peering specifics (if you opt in):
- We support standard AWS VPC peering (no BGP required). Static route entries are fine.
- Required inputs: your VPC ID, CIDR block, account ID for peering, and preferred peering window.
- Peering prechecks: we will validate no overlapping CIDR (our staging tenant uses 10.10.0.0/16).

Acceptance tests we will run once keys + allowlist are in place:
1) Auth smoke: token-based calls succeed for both keys (admin + integration-read).
2) Latency sample: 1000-token generation measured at three concurrency levels.
3) Bulk transfer: optional — 20GB transfer to validate peering throughput.

I attached a minimal vpc-peer-template.txt with the JSON fields we need (VPC_ID, CIDR, account_number, window). If you want, we can create the peering request on our side once you provide the account/VPC info.

Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: vpc-peer-template.txt (fields + sample command), network_requirements_20261121.pdf (referenced)

Subject: Re: MAP: MedLytics POC — environment handoff, API keys & peering cadence

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. Finalizing the MAP based on the thread and attachments; summarizing the agreed items and owners below. Please treat this as our source-of-truth for the sprint-run to close.

Mutual Action Plan (concise):
- 11/23 (COMPLETE): Redwood to create MedLytics staging org and provision onboarding-admin & integration-read keys (soojin + jonas).
- 11/25: MedLytics to provide egress IP list and confirm Priya as org admin (Alex/Priya) — pending (please confirm).
- 11/30 (TBD): VPC peering window (optional) — target evening maintenance window if accepted. Jonas will initiate once VPC_ID and account_number received.
- 12/06: Joint performance run & decision meeting (all) — aim to finalize next-step commercial outcome (extend trial vs move to a dedicated pilot).

Operational notes:
- API keys: onboarding-admin TTL=7d then rotate to integration-read. Integration-read will be treated as the long-lived token for CI. Jonas will provide the rotation script.
- IP allowlist: please send NAT/public IPs in CIDR format; we will update firewall entries on our side and confirm with an auth smoke.
- Peering: optional — if you opt out, still schedule a 1-hour bulk transfer test over public endpoints so we can compare unit costs.

Offline: I will push the MAP_MedLytics_v1.xlsx with the milestone column locked and add the DocuSign link for the trial letter (shared in related_links). Marissa — can you own the calendar invite for the 12/06 run and include a 30m pre-run sync?

Alex/Priya — if you confirm the egress IPs in the next 24 hours we will schedule the auth smoke for 11/26 morning.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth handoff.

Soojin
